title: Batch Normalization — Keep the Gauges Readable
key_insight: Batch normalization recenters and rescales a layer’s values using measurements from the current training batch.
body:
## Keep the Gauges Readable

Values entering a deep layer become huge in one batch and tiny in another. The next layer must keep adapting to a moving scale.

Batch normalization recenters and rescales a layer’s values using measurements from the current training batch.

It then learns its own shift and scale, so normalization does not remove the model’s ability to represent useful ranges.
common_mistakes: Batch normalization removes every learned parameter.
Evaluation should always use random batch measurements.
Normalization guarantees that overfitting cannot occur.
mini_exercise: Sketch the situation in “Keep the Gauges Readable” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Stable activation scales can allow faster, less fragile deep-network training.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “Keep the Gauges Readable” situation, explain Batch Normalization without assuming the listener knows deep learning.
